concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-grabpay-android-component]] — 2026-09-15 GrabPay Android Components v5.0.0 Sessions/Advanced add-on with Customer Area setup, no additional method fields/configuration stated, simulator testing and live request gate; its broad no-fields wording leaves PayLater scope unresolved against other GrabPay guides.
warnings: This Android v5 guide says no extra GrabPay fields without Wallet/PayLater distinction, while other pinned GrabPay guides require deliveryAddress and lineItems for PayLater; do not use this page alone to waive PayLater fields.
A test-wallet credential, simulator OTP or Customer Area status check is not payment-outcome proof.
